title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: An astronaut is left for dead on Mars and has to science his way through staying alive until someone can come back for him.
reasons: want hard sci-fi that is actually funny
like watching a smart person solve one problem after another
enjoy engineering detail and realistic space travel
want an optimistic book about people cooperating
dislikes: Mark Watney's jokes all have the same voice and wear thin
Characters on Earth are thin compared with the Mars sections
There is very little inner life; it is problem, fix, problem, fix
